description: Required for new construction, additions, structural changes, or major renovations

steps.action: Determine if you need a permit
steps.details: Contact Building Department at 555-0123 or visit city website permit lookup tool
Property survey, construction plans, contractor license (if applicable)
Submit in person at City Hall Room 201 or online at cityofmaplewood.gov/permits
Fees vary by project scope. Calculator available at cityofmaplewood.gov/permitfees
Call 555-0124 at least 48 hours before you need inspection

required_documents: Contractor license and insurance (if using contractor)
fees: Varies by project: $50-$500. Use online calculator for estimate.

faq.question: Do I need a permit for a deck?
faq.answer: Yes, if the deck is over 30 inches high or attached to the house.

faq.question: How long is my permit valid?
faq.answer: Permits are valid for 6 months. Extensions available upon request.

description: Required to operate a business within city limits

steps.details: Ensure your business type is allowed at your location. Call Planning at 555-0130
Download form at cityofmaplewood.gov/business or pick up at City Hall
Proof of insurance, lease agreement or property deed, seller's permit (if applicable)
Submit in person or by mail with $75 annual fee
Processing takes 5-7 business days. License must be displayed at business location

faq.question: Do I need a license for a home-based business?
faq.answer: Yes, all businesses operating in the city require a license, including home-based businesses.

faq.question: When does my license expire?
faq.answer: Business licenses expire December 31 each year and must be renewed annually.

description: Report potholes or street damage for repair

steps.details: Note the street name, nearest cross street, and approximate location
Online: cityofmaplewood.gov/report-pothole or call Public Works at 555-0150
Size of pothole, traffic hazard level, and your contact info (optional)
Keep this number to check status of your request

processing_time: Inspection within 2 business days, repair within 3-10 days based on priority

faq.question: How quickly will the pothole be fixed?
faq.answer: Repairs are prioritized by severity. Emergency hazards within 24 hours, others within 3-10 business days.

faq.question: Can I check the status of my report?
faq.answer: Yes, call Public Works at 555-0150 with your work order number.

description: Pay your monthly water and sewer bill

steps.details: Bills mailed monthly, due on the 15th of each month
Online, phone, mail, or in-person at City Hall
Online: cityofmaplewood.gov/paybill | Phone: 555-0160 | Mail: City Hall, PO Box 100

payment_methods: In person at City Hall (cash, check, card)
fees: No fee for check/e-check. $2.50 fee for credit/debit cards.
processing_time: Immediate for online/phone, 3-5 days for mail

faq.question: What if I can't pay my bill on time?
faq.answer: Contact Utility Billing at 555-0160 to discuss payment plan options before the due date.

faq.question: Why is my bill higher this month?
faq.answer: Check for leaks, seasonal usage changes, or rate adjustments. Call 555-0160 for bill explanation.
